semantics: Dashboard counts masterchain-anchored accepted blocks from validator logs, deduplicated by full block ID; generator independently fetches canonical proofs.
Dashboard uses consensus-acceptance-time minute buckets; generator uses fully contained block gen_utime seconds.
All four workchain-0 lane counts are summed; no extra factor of 16 is applied to transactions.
Peak minute rates and measured 179-second averages are different windows.
Native classification is independent of ADNL/tonlib/lite-client transport. The audited high-rate runs used persistent ADNL; tonlib was integration-tested at low volume, not benchmarked at 60k.
The current frontend defaults to last 2h and 60s windows; it has no automatic refresh timer.
Native-specific counting bug is identified and documented, not deployed as a fix.
